get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/audit-logs` — list audit log entries with filters and
cursor pagination (admin only). AUDIT-001.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor (oldest entry ULID from previous page)

post.description: Requires the current password for re-authentication.
Requires the current password. Old recovery codes are invalidated.

Returns the Base32 secret and `otpauth://` URI. The secret is not yet
active until verified via `POST /api/v1/auth/2fa/verify`.

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/auth/2fa/verify` — verify a TOTP code and enable 2FA.

post.description:
Returns 401 for unknown user, wrong password, or disabled account — the
same error for all three to avoid leaking user existence (AUTH-003).
Returns 429 if the account or IP is temporarily locked (AUTH-004).

Takes the challenge token from the login response and a TOTP code or
recovery code. On success, creates a session and sets the session cookie.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/auth/me` — return the current authenticated user.

post.description:
Returns 400 for invalid input (empty username, password too short).
Returns 409 if any users already exist (AUTH-001).

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/auth/status` — check whether an admin user exists.
get.description:
Side-effect-free probe so the client can choose between the setup wizard
and the login page without probing `POST /auth/setup` with dummy
credentials (DS-AUD-002). No authentication required.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/dashboard/latency` — recent latency records across all nodes
(admin). Returns the most recent records, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-200, default 50).

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/dashboard/traffic` — global traffic aggregate with per-source
and per-probe-source breakdown (admin). Surfaces probe source staleness
(PROBE-004) and traceable data provenance (PROBE-005).

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description:
If provided, restrict the aggregate to a single subscription ULID.
`None` (default) aggregates across all subscriptions.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/dashboard/traffic/history` — daily traffic history (admin).
get.description:
Returns daily traffic data points for the last `days` days (default 30).
When `subscription_id` is provided, history is scoped to that subscription;
otherwise points aggregate across all subscriptions. Days with no traffic
are filled with zero-value entries so the chart is continuous (TRAFFIC-002).

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description:
Restrict history to a single subscription ULID. `None` (default)
aggregates across all subscriptions.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description:
Number of days of history to return (1-365, default 30). The range
ends at the current UTC date.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/nodes` — list nodes with filters and cursor pagination
(admin only).

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/nodes/import` — manually import a batch of nodes (admin
only). NODE-001 / NODE-002 / NODE-003.
post.description:
Parses the request body content with the same protocol parsers used for
source refresh and imports the resulting nodes into the pool with
dedup by `(protocol_kind, host, port)`. Duplicates are counted but not
overwritten.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/nodes/{id}` — get a node by ID (admin only).

put.summary:
`PUT /api/v1/nodes/{id}/chain` — set or clear a node's proxy chain
(NODE-017 / NODE-018, admin only).

400.description: Invalid node id or chain structure

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/nodes/{id}/latency` — list recent latency records for a node.

patch.summary:
`PATCH /api/v1/nodes/{id}/override` — create or replace a node's manual
override (NODE-010, admin only).
`PATCH /api/v1/nodes/{id}/region` — set or clear a manual region (NODE-006).

put.summary: `PUT /api/v1/nodes/{id}/tags` — replace tags for a single node (NODE-005).

post.description:
Creates a `Pending` run and spawns the runner as a background task. The
response returns immediately with the run in `Pending` status; poll
`GET /api/v1/probe-runs/{id}` for progress.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/probe-runs/{id}` — get a probe run (admin only).
`GET /api/v1/probe-sources` — list probe sources (admin only).
`GET /api/v1/probe-sources/{id}` — get a probe source (admin only).

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/probe-sources/{id}/sync` — sync traffic from the external
panel (admin only). Triggers an immediate adapter call, writes
[`TrafficRecord`] rows for the bound subscription, and persists the new
encrypted counter snapshot + sync status (PROBE-001).

400.description: Invalid id or source not syncable

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/sources` — list sources with cursor pagination (admin only).

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/sources` — create a new subscription source (admin only).

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/sources/{id}` — get a source by ID (admin only).

post.description:
Fetches the subscription URL, parses the content, and reconciles the
parsed nodes into the pool. On fetch or parse failure, the last
successful snapshot remains active (constraint #19).

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/subscriptions` — list subscriptions with cursor pagination
(admin). Lists subscriptions owned by the authenticated admin.
`GET /api/v1/subscriptions/{id}` — get a subscription by ID (admin).

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/subscriptions/{id}/regenerate-short-code` — (re)generate the
short code for a subscription (admin). If a short code already exists, it is
replaced. The short code is a public lookup key, not a secret.

`POST /api/v1/subscriptions/{id}/rotate-token` — rotate the delivery token
(admin). The new plaintext token is returned once.

`POST /api/v1/subscriptions/{id}/temp-links` — create a temporary delivery
link (admin). The plaintext temp token is returned once and never persisted.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v1/subscriptions/{id}/temp-links/{temp_link_id}` — revoke a
temporary delivery link (admin). Subsequent delivery via the temp token
returns 404.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/subscriptions/{id}/traffic` — get aggregated traffic summary
for a subscription (admin). Returns consumed upload/download totals and a
per-source-kind breakdown.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/subscriptions/{id}/traffic-correction` — apply a manual
traffic correction (admin). Appends a `manual-correction` record; aggregation
is sum-based.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/tags` — list all tags (admin only).

delete.summary: `DELETE /api/v1/tags/{id}` — delete a tag by ID (admin only).

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/templates` — list templates with cursor pagination (admin).

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/templates` — create a new V3 subscription template (admin).

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/templates/{id}` — get a template by ID (admin).

`GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/compatibility?profile=` — check which
resolved nodes are compatible with a target profile (admin). Read-only.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Target profile: mihomo, sing-box, xray, v2ray, shadowrocket, uri_list

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/templates/{id}/generate?profile=&mode=` — generate a
subscription for the given template and target profile (admin). In strict
mode, returns 422 with the compatibility report if any node is excluded
(GEN-014). In lenient mode, excludes incompatible nodes and continues.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Target profile: mihomo, sing-box, xray, v2ray, shadowrocket, uri_list

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Generation mode: strict or lenient (default lenient)

404.description: Template or active version not found

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/generations/active?profile=` — get the
currently active (last successfully published) generation for a template +
profile (admin). Returns 404 if no active generation exists. On generation
failure, the previous active generation remains served (GEN-015,
constraint #19).

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Target profile: mihomo, sing-box, xray, v2ray, shadowrocket, uri_list

404.description: No active generation for this template + profile

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/templates/{id}/preview?profile=&mode=` — preview the
generation output for a template + profile without publishing (GEN-016).
On cache hit, returns the cached (active) content. On cache miss, runs the
full pipeline but does NOT store or activate. The returned content is
identical to what `generate` would produce (preview consistency, GEN-016).

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Target profile: mihomo, sing-box, xray, v2ray, shadowrocket, uri_list

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Generation mode: strict or lenient (default lenient)

404.description: Template or active version not found

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/resolve` — resolve the template's nodeSelector
and proxyGroups against the live node pool (admin). Read-only: no
generation, no caching, no state change.

409.description: Version belongs to a different template

`GET /api/v1/users` — list users with cursor pagination (admin only).

Returns 400 for invalid input (empty username, password too short).
Returns 409 if the username is already taken.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/users/{id}/disable` — disable a user and revoke all

Returns 409 if the target is the requesting admin's own account

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/users/{id}/force-logout` — revoke all sessions for a
user without disabling the account (admin only). AUTH-010.

get.summary: Liveness probe — returns 200 if the process is alive.
Readiness probe — returns 200 if the service is ready to serve requests.
get.description:
Checks database connectivity. Returns 503 with `degraded` status if the
database is unreachable.

ActiveGenerationResponse.description:
Response body for `GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/generations/active`.

Returns the currently active (last successfully published) generation for
the given template + profile. On generation failure, the previous active
generation remains served (GEN-015, constraint #19). Returns 404 if no
active generation exists.

cache_key.description: The cache key (SHA-256 hex) of the active entry.

pool_revision.description: The pool revision at the time of generation.

profile.description: The target profile that was generated.

template_version.description: The template version the active generation was produced from.

actor_id.description: The actor's ULID, or `null` for system/anonymous actions.

created_at.description: When the action was recorded (ISO 8601 UTC).

details_json.description: Non-sensitive metadata as a JSON string.

AuthStatusResponse.description:
Response body for `GET /api/v1/auth/status`.

Side-effect-free probe: tells the client whether an admin user has been
created yet. The client uses this to decide between the setup wizard
(`initialized == false`) and the login page (`initialized == true`).
Unlike probing `POST /auth/setup` with dummy credentials, this endpoint
never returns 400 for short passwords or 409 for existing admins — it
returns 200 with a boolean (DS-AUD-002).

initialized.description: Whether at least one admin user exists.

ChainEdgeDto.description: A directed edge in the chain proxy dependency graph.

CompatibilityReportDto.description:
Response body for `GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/compatibility`.

Reports which resolved nodes are included in and excluded from generation
for a given target profile. Incompatible nodes are never silently dropped
(constraint #7): they appear in `excluded` with a reason.

excluded.description: Nodes that are incompatible and excluded from generation.

included_node_ids.description: Node IDs that are compatible and will be included in generation.

auth_config.description:
Auth config (API token for Nezha; empty for DStatus/Komari). Encrypted
at rest with XChaCha20-Poly1305.

oneOf.description: Include/exclude filter rules (SRC-010). `None` means no filtering.

keep_on_fail.description: Whether to keep existing nodes if a refresh fails.

source_type.description: Input format. `auto` lets the fetcher detect.

expires_at.description: Subscription expiry as an ISO 8601 string. `null` = never expires.

node_selection.description:
Node selection configuration as a JSON object matching the V3
`nodeSelector` schema (`mode`, `filters`, `nodeIds`, `nodeRevision`).

template_id.description: The template ULID this subscription binds.

traffic_limit.description: Traffic limit in bytes. `null` = unlimited. Enforced at delivery.

CreateTempLinkRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/subscriptions/{id}/temp-links`.

A temp link is an alternative delivery token with a mandatory expiry and
revocation. The plaintext is returned once at creation; only the
HMAC-SHA256 digest is persisted.

expires_at.description: When the temp link expires (ISO 8601 UTC). Required.

token_plaintext.description: The plaintext temp link token. Shown once; store it securely.

CreateTemplateRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/templates`.

The `spec_yaml` field is the full V3 template document (apiVersion,
kind, metadata, spec) as a YAML string. The server validates it against
the M5 schema constraints before persistence (GEN-002).

spec_yaml.description: The full V3 template YAML document.

DashboardLatencyRecordDto.description: A single latency record in the dashboard latency view.

error_class.description: Error classification. `Ok` when the probe succeeded.

measured_at.description: When the measurement was taken (ISO 8601 UTC).

rtt_ms.description: Round-trip time in milliseconds. `None` = no response (NODE-014).

DashboardLatencyResponse.description:
Response body for `GET /api/v1/dashboard/latency`.

Returns the most recent latency records across all nodes, newest first.
Used by the admin dashboard to surface node health at a glance.

DashboardProbeSourceBreakdownDto.description:
Per probe-source traffic contribution in the dashboard traffic view.

Each entry corresponds to one configured probe source. The `upload` and
`download` are the sum of all `TrafficRecord` rows attributed to this
source (via `source_ref` prefix matching). The `last_sync_status` surfaces
staleness so the dashboard can mark stale data (PROBE-004).

download.description: Total download bytes attributed to this source.

last_sync_at.description: When the last sync was attempted (ISO 8601 UTC).

oneOf.description: Status of the last sync — `Ok`, `Failed { message }`, or `Stale`.

upload.description: Total upload bytes attributed to this source.

DashboardSourceKindBreakdownDto.description: Per source-kind traffic breakdown in the dashboard traffic view.

download.description: Total download bytes from this source kind.

upload.description: Total upload bytes from this source kind.

DashboardTrafficResponse.description:
Response body for `GET /api/v1/dashboard/traffic`.

Returns the global traffic aggregate across all subscriptions, broken down
by source kind and by individual probe source (PROBE-005 traceability).

total_download.description: Total download bytes across all subscriptions.

total_upload.description: Total upload bytes across all subscriptions.

ErrorClassDto.description: The error classification of a latency result.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response for auth endpoints.

ExcludedNodeDto.description:
A node excluded from generation because it is incompatible with the
requested target profile.

display_name.description: The node's display name at the time of exclusion.

GenerationResultDto.description:
Response body for `POST /api/v1/templates/{id}/generate`.

Contains the emitted subscription content for the requested target profile,
the compatibility report (included/excluded nodes), and any warnings
(missing references, empty pool). In strict mode, the request fails with
422 instead of returning this body when any node is excluded (GEN-014).

content.description:
The emitted subscription content (YAML for mihomo, JSON for
sing-box/xray/v2ray, base64 URI list for shadowrocket, plain URI list
for uri_list).

excluded.description: Nodes excluded from generation due to incompatibility.

included_node_ids.description: Node IDs included in the generated output.

profile.description: The target profile that was generated.

warnings.description:
Non-fatal warnings: missing references, nodes that became unavailable
during generation, or an empty compatible pool.

GroupResolutionDto.description: Resolution of a single proxy group's membership against the live pool.

explicit_node_ids.description:
Node IDs from explicit `GroupMember::Node` entries that were found and
active. Order matches the spec's `members` order.

group_name.description: The group name from the template spec.

missing.description: Explicit node references that could not be resolved.

quick_group_node_ids.description: Node IDs auto-populated by the group's quick-group filter.

HealthStatusDto.description: Overall health status reported by health probes.

ImportNodesRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/nodes/import` (NODE-001/002).

The `content` is a raw subscription payload (URI list, Base64, YAML, or
JSON). The server parses it with the same protocol parsers used for
source refresh and imports the resulting nodes into the pool with
dedup. `source_type` controls format detection; `auto` lets the server
detect from the content.

content.description: Raw subscription content to parse and import.

source_type.description: Input format. `auto` lets the server detect.

duplicate_nodes.description: Nodes already present (duplicate of an existing active node).

failed.description: Input lines that could not be parsed.

new_nodes.description: Nodes newly inserted into the pool.

outcomes.description: Per-line outcomes for diagnostics. Length equals the input line count.

oneOf.description: A new node was inserted; `data` is the node ULID.

data.description: A new node was inserted; `data` is the node ULID.

oneOf.description: The node was a duplicate; `data` is the existing node ULID.

data.description: The node was a duplicate; `data` is the existing node ULID.

oneOf.description: The line could not be parsed; `data` is the raw input text.

data.description: The line could not be parsed; `data` is the raw input text.

ImportOutcomeDto.description: Per-line outcome of a manual import.

measured_at.description: When the measurement was taken (ISO 8601 UTC).

rtt_ms.description: Round-trip time in milliseconds. `None` means no response (NODE-014).

run_id.description: The probe run that produced this record.

entries.description: Audit log entries in the current page (newest first).

next_cursor.description:
Cursor for the next page (`None` if no more results). The cursor is
the oldest entry's ULID in the current page.
Cursor for the next page (`None` if no more results).
Cursor for the next page (`None` if no more results).
Cursor for the next page (`None` if no more results).
Cursor for the next page (`None` if no more results).
Cursor for the next page (`None` if no more results).
Cursor for the next page (`None` if no more results).

LoginResponse.description:
Response body for `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.

When `requires_2fa` is `true`, the client must complete the 2FA flow
using the `challenge_token` via `POST /api/v1/auth/login/2fa`. The
session cookie is NOT set in this case.

challenge_token.description:
Challenge token for the 2FA login endpoint. Present only when
`requires_2fa` is `true`.

requires_2fa.description: Whether 2FA verification is required to complete login.

challenge_token.description: Challenge token from the login response.

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code or a recovery code.

ManualCorrectionRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/subscriptions/{id}/traffic-correction`.

Records a manual traffic correction (admin escape hatch for drifted totals).
The correction is appended like any other record; aggregation is sum-based.

note.description: Admin note explaining the correction (max 512 chars).

recorded_at.description: When the record was created (ISO 8601 UTC).

MissingNodeRefDto.description: A node reference that could not be resolved to an active pool entry.

node_id.description: The node ULID that was referenced.

reason.description:
Why the node is unavailable: `not_found`, `missing_from_source`, or
`inactive`.

nodes.description: The node IDs forming the chain. Empty means direct connection.

NodeDto.description:
A node in the unified pool, as returned by list/get endpoints.

Pool metadata (`missing_from_source`, `is_active`, `revision`) is
included alongside the canonical node fields. Sensitive fields
(raw URI with embedded credentials) are never serialized.

chain.description:
Ordered node IDs forming this node's proxy chain. Empty means direct
connection (no chain). See NODE-017.

host.description: Endpoint host (IPv6 bracketed in URI form).

is_active.description: Whether the node is active (eligible for generation).

missing_from_source.description: Whether the node was marked missing after its source removed it.

region_method.description: How the region was assigned (auto-detected or manual override).

source_label.description: Source label (the source name, or `"manual"` for pasted nodes).

NodeOverrideDto.description: Manual override applied to a node, as seen in API responses.

display_name.description: Override display name; `None` keeps the parsed name.

enabled.description: Override enabled flag; `None` keeps natural status.

region.description: Override region; `None` keeps the auto-detected region.

NodeTagAssignmentDto.description: One node's tag assignment in a batch tags request.

ProbeRunDto.description: Probe run information returned by probe run endpoints.

completed_at.description: Terminal time (ISO 8601 UTC). `None` if still pending or running.

results.description: Per-node results. Populated as probes complete.

ProbeRunResultDto.description: Per-node result within a probe run.

rtt_ms.description: Round-trip time in milliseconds. `None` means no response (NODE-014).

skipped.description: Whether this node's probe was skipped (run cancelled before it started).

ProbeRunStatusDto.description: The status of a probe run.

ProbeSourceDto.description:
Probe source information returned by probe source endpoints.

Never includes the raw `auth_config` ciphertext in responses.

has_auth.description:
Whether an auth credential is configured (the credential itself is not
returned).

last_sync_at.description: When the last sync was attempted (ISO 8601 UTC).

ProbeSourceKindDto.description: The kind of external probe panel.

ReconcileCountsDto.description: Reconciliation counts returned by a source refresh.

duplicate_nodes.description: Nodes already in the pool (duplicate of an existing active node).

missing_nodes.description: Nodes previously bound to this source that are no longer present.

new_nodes.description: Nodes newly inserted into the pool.

reactivated_nodes.description: Nodes that were missing and have been reactivated.

node_count.description: Number of nodes in the snapshot.

not_modified.description: Whether the server returned 304 Not Modified.

snapshot_id.description: ULID of the snapshot created (or the previously active one on 304).

RegenerateRecoveryCodesRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/auth/2fa/recovery-codes`.

Requires the current password to prevent unauthorized regeneration.

recovery_codes.description: New single-use recovery codes (old codes are invalidated).

RegionMethodDto.description: How a node's region was assigned.

ResolveTemplateResponse.description:
Response body for `GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/resolve`.

Resolves the template's `nodeSelector` and `proxyGroups` against the live
node pool. Read-only: no generation, no caching, no state change.

chain_edges.description:
Directed edges in the chain proxy dependency graph. Each edge
represents a `from → to` dependency (relay sequence or group
reference). Empty when the template has no relay groups or
group-to-group references.

groups.description: Per-group resolution for each `ProxyGroup` in the spec.

selected_node_ids.description: Node IDs selected by the template's `nodeSelector`.

selection_missing.description: Node IDs from the selector that were referenced but unavailable.

RotateTokenRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/subscriptions/{id}/rotate-token`.

`grace_seconds` controls the rotation grace period: during grace, both the
old and new tokens remain valid. `null` or `-1` means permanent grace (the
old token stays valid indefinitely). `0` means no grace (the old token is
immediately invalid).

grace_seconds.description: Grace period in seconds. `null` or `-1` = permanent grace.

SetNodeChainRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/v1/nodes/{id}/chain` (NODE-017 / NODE-018).

`nodes` is the ordered list of node IDs to route traffic through. An
empty array clears the chain (direct connection). The server validates
non-emptiness is not required when clearing, but a non-empty array must
not contain the node itself, duplicates, non-existent nodes, or form a
cycle.

nodes.description: Ordered node IDs forming the chain. Empty clears the chain.

tag_ids.description: Tag IDs to assign to this node (replaces existing assignments).

region.description: `Some("US")` sets a manual region; `None` clears it.

ShortCodeResponse.description:
Response body for `POST /api/v1/subscriptions/{id}/regenerate-short-code`.

The short code is a CSPRNG-generated base62 string (8 chars). Unlike the
delivery token, it is not a secret — it is a public lookup key for
`GET /s/{code}`. If a short code already exists, it is replaced.

code.description: The public base62 short code string (e.g. `"aB3xK9mQ"`).

SourceDto.description:
Source information returned by source management endpoints.

Never includes encrypted headers ciphertext in responses.

oneOf.description: Include/exclude filter rules (SRC-010). `None` means no filtering.

keep_on_fail.description: Whether to keep existing nodes if a refresh fails.

SourceFilterRulesDto.description:
Include/exclude filter rules applied to parsed nodes before reconcile
(SRC-010).

exclude_protocols.description: Protocols to drop; takes precedence over `include_protocols`.

exclude_regions.description: Regions to drop; takes precedence over `include_regions`.

include_protocols.description: Protocols to keep; empty means keep all.

include_regions.description: Regions to keep; empty means keep all.

SourceTypeDto.description: Input format of a subscription source.

SubscriptionDto.description: Subscription information returned by subscription management endpoints.

node_selection.description: Node selection configuration as a JSON object.

short_code.description:
The active short code string, if one has been generated. `null` = no
short code. Delivery via `GET /s/{code}` resolves this to the
subscription.

template_version_pin.description: Pinned template version. `null` follows the template's active version.

SubscriptionResponse.description:
Response body for `POST /api/v1/subscriptions`.

The `token_plaintext` is the CSPRNG-generated delivery token shown exactly
once at creation time. The server stores only the HMAC-SHA256 digest; the
plaintext is never persisted and never appears in logs (SEC-009).

token_plaintext.description: The plaintext delivery token. Shown once; store it securely.

samples_written.description: Number of traffic samples written in this sync.

snapshot_updated.description: Whether the encrypted counter snapshot was updated.

source.description: The probe source after sync (with updated `last_sync_at`/status).

oneOf.description: The last sync failed with the given message.

SyncStatusDto.description: Sync status of a probe source's last traffic sync.

TemplateDto.description: Template information returned by template management endpoints.

active_version.description: The active version number. `0` before the first version is committed.

active_version_id.description: The active version's ULID, if any.

version.description: The version created by this operation.

is_active.description: Whether this is the active version.

template_id.description: The template this version belongs to.

token_id.description: The token row ULID (stable across rotations).

token_plaintext.description: The new plaintext delivery token. Shown once; store it securely.

TrafficHistoryPointDto.description: A single day's traffic data point in the history chart (TRAFFIC-002).

total_download.description: Total download bytes for this day.

total_upload.description: Total upload bytes for this day.

TrafficHistoryResponse.description:
Response body for `GET /api/v1/dashboard/traffic/history` (TRAFFIC-002).

Returns daily traffic history points. When `subscription_id` is omitted,
points aggregate across all subscriptions. Days with no traffic are filled
with zero-value entries so the chart is continuous.

points.description: Daily traffic data points, ordered by date ascending.

scoped_to_subscription.description: Whether the query was scoped to a single subscription.

TrafficHistorySourceBreakdownDto.description: Per source-kind breakdown entry in a [`TrafficHistoryPointDto`].

download.description: Download bytes from this source kind on this day.

upload.description: Upload bytes from this source kind on this day.

download.description: Download bytes from this source kind.

upload.description: Upload bytes from this source kind.

TrafficSummaryResponse.description:
Response body for `GET /api/v1/subscriptions/{id}/traffic`.

Returns the aggregated consumed traffic for a subscription, broken down by
source kind. The `total` is `upload + download`. Used by the admin traffic
dashboard and to verify quota enforcement state (OUT-010/OUT-011).

download.description: Total download bytes across all source kinds.

upload.description: Total upload bytes across all source kinds.

TwoFactorDisableRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/auth/2fa/disable`.

Requires the current password to prevent unauthorized disabling from a
hijacked session.

TwoFactorSetupResponse.description:
Response body for `POST /api/v1/auth/2fa/setup`.

Returns the TOTP secret (Base32) for manual entry and an `otpauth://` URI
for QR code generation. The secret is not yet active until verified.

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code from the user's authenticator app.

TwoFactorVerifyResponse.description:
Response body for `POST /api/v1/auth/2fa/verify`.

Recovery codes are shown once. The user must store them securely.

display_name.description: Override display name; `None` clears the override.

UpdateProbeSourceRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/v1/probe-sources/{id}`. Only provided fields are
mutated.

auth_config.description: Auth config. Replaces the existing credential.

subscription_id.description:
Bound subscription ULID. `None` clears the binding; omitting the field
leaves it unchanged.

oneOf.description: Include/exclude filter rules (SRC-010). `None` means no filtering.

keep_on_fail.description: Whether to keep existing nodes if a refresh fails.

enabled.description: Whether delivery is enabled. `null` preserves the current value.

expires_at.description: Subscription expiry as an ISO 8601 string. `null` = never expires.

node_selection.description: Node selection configuration as a JSON object.

template_version_pin.description: Pinned template version. `null` follows the template's active version.

spec_yaml.description: The full V3 template YAML document.

UserDto.description:
User information returned by auth and user management endpoints.

Never includes `password_hash` or other secrets.

enabled.description: Whether the user can log in.

expires_at.description: Optional account expiry (ISO 8601 UTC). `None` means no expiry.

last_login_at.description: Last successful login time (ISO 8601 UTC). `None` if never logged in.
